Subject: Billing cadence options for Hosted API

Hi Marissa,

Quick one from procurement — our finance team prefers consolidated monthly invoices on Net terms, but we also need a card fallback for spikes under $1k. Can Redwood support a setup where we get a consolidated invoice (single PO) but token charges can fall back to our company card for any out-of-band spend?

Also: can you confirm what information you need for invoice consolidation (PO number format, billing contact, tax ID) and whether you support Net30 vs Net45? We’re evaluating whether to pursue a reserved capacity contract but want standard hosted API billing clarified first.

Attaching our PO stub for reference.

Thanks,

BrightRoute Inc.

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the PO stub. Short answers up front: yes, we typically support consolidated monthly invoicing (one invoice per month tied to a PO) and we offer a card-on-file fallback for small/one-off charges. Net terms are possible but require a credit check/Finance review (Net30 is standard; Net45 can be approved case-by-case).

What I need from you to move this to contract stage:
- Expected monthly spend range (helps determine discounts / whether Finance requires a deposit)
- Billing contact name, email, and billing address exactly as it should appear on invoice
- PO number format you expect (if you want consolidated invoices grouped by PO)
- Any tax-exemption certificates or reseller details

I attached our latest rate card (redwood-ratecard-v2.pdf) — it has hosted API baseline pricing and bulk discount thresholds. If you expect >$250k ARR-ish, we can also discuss an upfront credit or committed spend discount.

Ben (cc) will triage the net-terms approval path; Lauren can confirm invoice formatting/ops. I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan after your reply.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Marissa — quick ops note to include in the MAP and finance runbook:

- For consolidated monthly invoices we require:
  * Formal PO on file (we can accept the one attached and request any missing fields)
  * Billing contact + email for remittance (different from technical contact is fine)
  * Tax ID where applicable (we store it in billing system)
- Net terms: Finance will run a soft credit check. If terms are >Net30 (e.g., Net45), approvals go to Head of Revenue and legal for contract addendum. Typical turnaround 3–7 business days once we have PO + billing contact.
- Card fallback: we support a card-on-file with automated retry and notification. If card hits the cap (you can set a threshold) a charge is automatically attempted and an invoice is still generated for reconciliation.

Also: when a customer wants invoice consolidation across multiple Redwood teams/lines (e.g., hosted + dedicated), include the list of tenant IDs in the PO so our billing can group charges properly.

I’ll draft the finance checklist and share a short template PO field list — Marissa, want me to include that in the MAP?

—Ben
Senior Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
